parameters.query:
ALTER TABLE clients_master ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS list_segment TEXT;

UPDATE clients_master SET list_segment = CASE
  WHEN status = 'New' THEN 'fresh_lead'
  WHEN status IN ('Qualified','Contacted','Replied') AND score = 'hot' THEN 'hot_active_outreach'
  WHEN status IN ('Nurtured') THEN 'long_term_nurture'
  WHEN status IN ('Onboarded','Active') THEN 'active_client'
  WHEN status = 'Churn Risk' THEN 'churn_risk'
  WHEN promoter_flag = true THEN 'promoter'
  ELSE list_segment
END;

SELECT list_segment, count(*) AS segment_count FROM clients_master GROUP BY list_segment;

nodes.name: Postgres - Refresh list_segment Tags
nodes.notes: Adds list_segment as a live-computed tag on clients_master itself (matches this build's own rule: extend the existing table with ALTER...ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, no new parallel table for the same entity). Segment names are a starting set -- add more CASE branches as new segments are needed for Stage 14 list-building use cases.

nodes.name: Report to Hub
nodes.notes: S6-gap-fill — IMPORTANT DEVIATION from usual convention: 7.2 ye ek bulk, all-rows-at-once UPDATE hai (no WHERE clause, no single lead/client), isliye ismein client_id/odoo_lead_id wala per-lead shape fit hi nahi baithta jaisa baaki har module me hai. client_id/odoo_lead_id dono explicitly null bheje hain (Hub-Intake ye already handle karta hai -- 'client_id ?? null', S1.1 ke notes dekho). event_type naya hai: list_segment.refreshed -- taxonomy doc me pehle se nahi tha, is batch me add kiya, 1.3 ke lead.captured jaisa hi treat kiya (purely informational/traceability ke liye, koi consumer abhi nahi, Dispatcher me wire nahi kiya). Postgres query me ek SELECT...GROUP BY add kiya sirf isliye taaki payload me kuch meaningful (per-segment counts) jaaye, warna UPDATE ke baad koi useful row hi nahi milta report karne ko.
